description:
This process kicks off when a department identifies the need for a new hire.
HR creates a job description and posts it on job boards.
Resumes are collected and screened, followed by initial phone interviews.
Selected candidates are invited for in-person or virtual interviews depending on each candidate's preference.
Once a candidate is chosen, an offer is extended, and salary negotiations may take place.
After the offer is accepted, the onboarding process begins, including paperwork, orientation, and training.
The process concludes once all onboarding steps are completed and the new hire is fully integrated into the team.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/recruitment">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Recruitment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Recruitment" name="Recruitment process" processRef="Process_Recruitment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Candidate" name="Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invite" name="Interview invitation" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Participant_Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Preference" name="Interview preference" sourceRef="Participant_Candidate" targetRef="Task_ReceivePreference"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Job offer" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Participant_Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Offer acceptance" sourceRef="Participant_Candidate" targetRef="Event_OfferAccepted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Recruitment" name="Recruitment and onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_NeedIdentified" name="Need for a new hire identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostJobDescription" name="Post job description on job boards"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectResumes" name="Collect resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScreenResumes" name="Screen resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterviews" name="Conduct initial phone interviews"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCandidates" name="Select candidates for interviews"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteCandidates" name="Invite selected candidates"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePreference" name="Receive candidate interview preference"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewFormat" name="Choose interview format"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Merge interview paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseCandidate" name="Choose candidate"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Negotiation" name="Salary negotiation needed?">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Negotiate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SkipNegotiation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Conduct salary negotiations"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" name="Merge negotiation paths"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferAccepted" name="Offer accepted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OfferAccepted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete onboarding paperwork"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductOrientation" name="Conduct orientation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_FullyIntegrated" name="New hire fully integrated into the team"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Create" sourceRef="Event_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Create_Post" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Post_Collect" sourceRef="Task_PostJobDescription" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Screen" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Screen_Phone" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Phone_Select" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterviews" targetRef="Task_SelectCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Invite" sourceRef="Task_SelectCandidates" targetRef="Task_InviteCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invite_Preference" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Task_ReceivePreference"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preference_Format" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePreference" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Format_InPerson" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">candidate preference is in-person</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Format_Virtual" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">candidate preference is virtual</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InPerson_Merge" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Virtual_Merge" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Choose" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ChooseCandidate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choose_Offer" sourceRef="Task_ChooseCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offer_Negotiation" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_Negotiation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">salary negotiation takes place</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipNegotiation" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate_Merge" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiation_Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" targetRef="Event_OfferAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accepted_Paperwork" sourceRef="Event_OfferAccepted" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Paperwork_Orientation" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Task_ConductOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Orientation_Training" sourceRef="Task_ConductOrientation" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_End" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Event_FullyIntegrated"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Negotiation" name="Salary negotiation needed?" default="Flow_SkipNegotiation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
